Example Simulation Truth

Source: R/example_data.R
gs_example_truth.Rd

Known additive and genotype-by-environment marker effects used to simulate the example BLUEs. This table is supplied for validation and teaching only. It must not be used to select markers before assessing prediction on the same phenotypes, because that would leak the simulated outcome-generating truth.

Usage

gs_example_truth

Format

A data frame with 240 rows and six columns: `MarkerID`, `AdditiveEffect`, `GxEEffect`, `CHR`, `POS`, and `Block`. Effects are zero for markers not sampled as causal.

Source

Generated by `data-raw/generate_example_data.R`.

Examples

data(gs_example_truth)
subset(gs_example_truth, AdditiveEffect != 0 | GxEEffect != 0)
